slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to minimize the total cost (sum of purchase costs, slow repair costs, and fast repair costs) across all 10 stages?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the optimization objective and confirmed minimizing total tool cost.

slot_scores.name: mandatory_repair_after_each_stage
slot_scores.evidence_quote: When a tool is used in a stage, does it always become broken at the end of that stage (so every used tool must be repaired or replaced before it can be used again), or does a used tool have some chance of staying working?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether every used tool must be repaired before reuse, covering the mandatory repair rule.

slot_scores.name: fast_repair_return_timing
slot_scores.evidence_quote: For fast repair, does a tool sent for fast repair at the end of stage j become available at the start of stage j+q (usable during stage j+q), following the same convention as slow repair?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the exact return timing for fast-repaired tools.

stopping_behavior.rationale: All P0 and P1 hidden slots were resolved before the agent reached the final modeling state; remaining unresolved items were lower-priority or outside the hidden-slot set.

summary: The agent systematically clarified the objective, mandatory repair rule, and fast-repair return timing, resolving all P0/P1 hidden slots before stopping. The interaction quality was strong, with no material silent assumptions on the scored hidden slots.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
